description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding one mana of any color for each charge counter on it.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Empowered Autogenerator and Candelabra of Tawnos as they are lands due to Toph.
Repeat.

uses.name: Empowered Autogenerator
uses.cardState: with a charge counter on it
